### Jehoiakim Burns the Word of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jehoiakim-burns-word-god
Passage: Jeremiah 36:23-24
Points:
- God showed extraordinary patience toward Judah for centuries before bringing judgment.
- King Jehoiakim brazenly rejected God by cutting up and burning Jeremiah's scroll column by column.
- The king and his royal attendants showed neither fear nor grief at the Lord's warnings.
- This defiant act marked a critical turning point that made the Babylonian exile inevitable.
- Earthly rulers cannot destroy God's Word, which the Lord faithfully preserved and re-recorded.

### Bible Pathways 08/24/04
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-08-or-24-or-04-1277343.html
Passage: Jeremiah 36:23
Points:
- Jehoiakim cut up the prophet's scroll with a penknife and tossed it into the hearth.
- Slicing and burning the scroll was powerless to overturn the divine truth it declared.
- Refusing to heed God's warnings inevitably brings severe consequences.
- Neglecting to read the Scriptures has the same spiritual effect as burning them.
- God remains faithful to bless and sustain those who stay loyal to Him.
